parsed.name: Slice-DHV压电驱动器单通道
parsed.description: Vescent Photonics Slice-DHV 压电驱动器的单个通道，用于实验中对压电执行器进行独立驱动与参数控制，以支持精密位移或调谐相关应用。
parsed.description_en: A single channel of the Vescent Photonics Slice-DHV piezo driver, used in experiments for independent control of a piezo actuator to support precision positioning or tuning applications.
